title: luce model card sidecar
description: Sidecar JSON carrying the per-model defaults Lucebox serves with, starting from the upstream model card. Read by luce_server at startup to set --default-max-tokens, --think-max-tokens, sampler, and reasoning.effort tier values. See docs/specs/thinking-budget.md §3.3 for the full field reference.

name.description: Display name. Informational; the filename is what matters for lookup.

source.description: URL of the upstream model card we transcribed.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the values were last checked against the source.

max_tokens.description: The card's standard recommended combined cap. Drives default_max_tokens.

download_urls.description: Optional. Map of variant tag (e.g. Q4_K_M, bf16) to GGUF download URL. Used by deployment tooling to resolve a sidecar to a concrete artifact.

complex_problem_max_tokens.description: Optional. Card's recommendation for hard reasoning / benchmark workloads. Drives x-high and max effort tiers.

hard_limit_reply_budget.description: Optional. Tokens reserved post-`</think>` for the visible answer phase. When `(n_gen - generated) <= hard_limit_reply_budget` during decode, the engine injects `thinking_terminator_hint` (or the bare `thinking_marker` if no hint is set). Default 4096 (raised from 512 on 2026-05-25 — the original was sized for DeepSeek-V4-flash's terse style but silently truncated almost every other model mid-answer). Terse models can override down to 512-1024; verbose math/code models keep 4096. Drives both `think_max_tokens = max_tokens - hard_limit_reply_budget` and the force-close trigger in do_ar_decode.

thinking_marker.description: Optional. Bytes that signal end-of-thinking to PARSERS — bench grader, chat template, response formatter, started_in_thinking detect. If empty, the server uses arch defaults (`</think>` for qwen3-family, `<channel|>` for gemma4, `</think>` elsewhere). Sidecar override exists for arches we haven't enumerated yet; for current arches leave empty.

thinking_terminator_hint.description:
Optional. Trained directive injected mid-stream when the budget hook fires. Tells the MODEL to wrap up. Tokenized at startup; the AR decode loop overrides sampled tokens with this sequence verbatim when `(n_gen - generated) <= hard_limit_reply_budget`. The server does NOT auto-append the marker — if the operator wants the close marker in the inject, they include it in the hint. This lets callers test whether a hint alone induces self-close (model emits marker itself) vs a full directive+marker (we force the close). For Qwen3.x the canonical hint per the Qwen3 technical report (arXiv 2505.09388) DOES include the marker: 'Considering the limited time by the user, I have to give the solution based on the thinking directly now.
</think>

'. If empty, the server emits the bare `thinking_marker` only — safe but the model may continue derivation in content space.

default_sampling.description: Optional. greedy: a request that sets no temperature decodes greedily, and one that does not sample (no temperature, or 0) gets no penalties; `sampling` and `sampling_no_thinking` fill in only for a request that sets a temperature above 0. sampling (the default): they fill in for every request.

sampling.description: Optional. The upstream card's sampler recipe; used when the request omits a field (with default_sampling greedy, only when it samples).

sampling_no_thinking.description: Optional. Same shape as `sampling`, but applied instead of it when a request's final thinking state resolves to OFF (e.g. chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, reasoning.effort="none", thinking.type="disabled"). Some model cards (e.g. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) document distinct thinking vs. instruct sampling recipes. Only fields present here override the `sampling` defaults for no-thinking requests; an omitted field keeps falling back to `sampling`. If this block is absent entirely, no-thinking requests use `sampling` exactly as before.

reasoning_effort_tiers.description: Optional. Explicit per-tier phase-1 budgets. Overrides any computed default. Use when ratio-based defaults don't fit the model.

notes.description: Optional. Free-form notes about provenance, caveats, or non-card-derived choices.

default_profile.description: Optional. The profile luce_server applies to this model served alone, without --profile, when the visible GPUs start with the profile's gpus and have its min_gpu_memory_gib; with a list, the first that matches. Each must name one of `profiles` that lists its gpus (luce_server and its unit tests check this; JSON Schema cannot).

profiles.description: Optional. Launch profiles by name (names and aliases unique across the cards; not none), picked with --profile <name>. Everything a profile sets is a default: command-line flags replace it, --no-<flag> leaves a flag out, and environment variables already set keep their value.

aliases.description: Earlier names --profile still accepts for this profile.

summary.description: What the profile runs where; logged at startup.

gpus.description: GPU architectures the profile was qualified on, from hip:0 upward.

min_gpu_memory_gib.description: The memory each of gpus needs to take this profile by default, in GiB as KFD reports it (a discrete GPU's VRAM; on the Strix Halo, its GTT size); 0 for any. One per gpus entry.

flags.description: luce_server flags in order: a string value, or true for a flag without one. share/... values resolve against the install.

env.description: Environment defaults installed at model load.

notes.description: Why the values are what they are.
